  cd /tmp
  curl -fsSL https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.61.0/gh_2.61.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o gh.tar.gz

  cd /tmp

  tar xzf docker.tgz --strip-components=1 -C /home/node/.local/bin/ docker/docker

1:
PLUGIN_FLAGS="--accept-capabilities --acknowledge-install-policy-warning"
# Memini ships via ClawHub; pin to the latest published artifact, git tags can lead it.
MEMINI_PLUGIN_VERSION=0.7.29
if [ "$(cat "$HOME/.openclaw/extensions/memini/.clawver" 2>/dev/null)" != "$MEMINI_PLUGIN_VERSION" ]; then
  if node dist/index.js plugins install "clawhub:@eleboucher/memini@$MEMINI_PLUGIN_VERSION" --force $PLUGIN_FLAGS; then
    printf '%s' "$MEMINI_PLUGIN_VERSION" > "$HOME/.openclaw/extensions/memini/.clawver"
  else
    echo "WARN: memini plugin install failed; starting with whatever is present"
  fi
fi
# Official npm plugins (not bundled in the image) must track the gateway version.
OPENCLAW_VERSION="$(node dist/index.js --version | awk '{print $2}')"
OFFICIAL_MARKER="$HOME/.openclaw/extensions/.official-plugins-version"
if [ -n "$OPENCLAW_VERSION" ] && [ "$(cat "$OFFICIAL_MARKER" 2>/dev/null)" != "$OPENCLAW_VERSION" ]; then
  if node dist/index.js plugins update comfy $PLUGIN_FLAGS \
    && node dist/index.js plugins update "@openclaw/discord@$OPENCLAW_VERSION" $PLUGIN_FLAGS \
    && node dist/index.js plugins update searxng $PLUGIN_FLAGS; then
    printf '%s' "$OPENCLAW_VERSION" > "$OFFICIAL_MARKER"
  else
    echo "WARN: official plugin update failed; starting with installed versions"
  fi
fi
if [ -f "$HOME/.openclaw/workspace/image-ui/app.py" ]; then
  cd "$HOME/.openclaw/workspace/image-ui" && python3 app.py &
fi
exec node dist/index.js gateway
